focus.fra_northern_industry: Coal and Steel of the North

focus_desc.deu_airborne: Develop the equipment and tactics for troops landing behind enemy lines by parachute and glider.
focus_desc.deu_anti_comintern: Sign a pact with Japan against the Communist International. Its secret annex is aimed at the Soviet Union.
focus_desc.deu_army_misgivings: The generals fear a hasty war will ruin the country. Doubt about the regime spreads through the officer corps.
focus_desc.deu_arsenal: Open more munitions and weapons plants to keep pace with the army's growth.
focus_desc.deu_austria_question: Prepare to press Vienna for union with Germany. Austria's own Nazi movement grows stronger.
focus_desc.deu_autobahn: Put the unemployed to work on a national motorway network. Wide roads will also speed the army's movements.
focus_desc.deu_balkan_partners: Bring Hungary, Romania, Bulgaria and Yugoslavia into the pact to secure the southeastern flank and its oil.
focus_desc.deu_battle_fleet: Build a fleet of battleships and cruisers able to face the Royal Navy on the open sea.
focus_desc.deu_bohemia_question: Put pressure on what is left of Czechoslovakia, stripped of its border forts at Munich.
focus_desc.deu_buna: Set up mass production of Buna synthetic rubber, so the wheels keep turning if imports are cut off.
focus_desc.deu_chemicals: Expand the plants that make explosives and synthetic materials, and fund process research.
focus_desc.deu_combined_arms: Train tanks, infantry, artillery and aircraft to fight together under one command.
focus_desc.deu_constitution: Revive parliament and elections and hand power to a civilian government. There is upheaval, but the rule of law returns.
focus_desc.deu_danzig_question: Prepare to demand the Free City of Danzig and a road and railway across the Polish Corridor.
focus_desc.deu_dispersal: Move exposed western factories deep into the east and spread them out against bombing.
focus_desc.deu_dive_bombers: Give priority to developing and using dive bombers that support the ground forces closely.
focus_desc.deu_east_war: With the West settled, draw up the plan to invade the Soviet Union. Army and economy turn east.
focus_desc.deu_eastern_bulwark: Guarantee Poland and the Baltic states and fortify the eastern frontier against any Soviet push west.
focus_desc.deu_finnish_transit: Seek the right to move troops across Finland to northern Norway. After the Winter War, Helsinki is looking for a patron.
focus_desc.deu_four_year_plan: Put raw-material self-sufficiency and arms output first, so the economy is ready for war within four years. Consumer goods come second.
focus_desc.deu_infantry: Raise more infantry divisions and set up regional replacement battalions to fill losses quickly.
focus_desc.deu_kwi: Raise the budget of the Kaiser Wilhelm Society's institutes, fostering both basic and applied research.
focus_desc.deu_luftwaffe: Equip the air force, revealed to the world in 1935, with new fighters and bombers in large numbers.
focus_desc.deu_machine_tools: Standardize machine tools and parts so factories can share work and run more efficiently.
focus_desc.deu_memel_question: Prepare to demand the return of the Memel Territory, ruled by Lithuania since 1923.
focus_desc.deu_moscow_envoy: Open talks with the ideological enemy. Neither side wants its hands tied over Poland.
focus_desc.deu_motorized: Form truck-borne infantry divisions that can keep pace with the panzers.
focus_desc.deu_mountain: Refine the organization and kit of the mountain divisions trained for alpine warfare.
focus_desc.deu_pact_of_steel: Conclude a military alliance with Italy: if one goes to war, the other fights alongside.
focus_desc.deu_panzer_arm: Build up an arm that groups tanks into independent panzer divisions instead of spreading them among the infantry.
focus_desc.deu_plan_z: Adopt a building programme for a large fleet of battleships and carriers by the mid-1940s.
focus_desc.deu_polish_alignment: Draw Poland into an anti-Soviet bloc and settle Danzig at the table. Germany's gaze turns east.
focus_desc.deu_rearm_industry: Ignore the Versailles arms limits and add weapons plants. Rearmament, once hidden, is now out in the open.
focus_desc.deu_rhineland: Send troops into the demilitarized Rhineland. It breaks the Locarno Treaty, but Berlin wagers the Western powers will not act.
focus_desc.deu_rome_berlin: Reach out to Italy, isolated after its invasion of Ethiopia. The two regimes agree to keep their foreign policies in step.
focus_desc.deu_ruhr: Raise output in the coalfields and steelworks of the Ruhr, the heart of rearmament in the west.
focus_desc.deu_salzgitter: Build a large state steelworks at Salzgitter to smelt low-grade German iron ore.
focus_desc.deu_september_plan: A circle of officers plans to remove the regime before it drags the country into war. If it works, the army will form a provisional government.
focus_desc.deu_silesia: Expand the mines and works of Silesia to share the load of the western industrial belt.
focus_desc.deu_staff_college: Widen the War Academy's courses to produce staff officers able to run divisions and corps.
focus_desc.deu_sudeten_question: Turn the grievances of the Sudeten Germans into an international crisis. The government in Prague is shaken.
focus_desc.deu_synthetic_fuel: Build hydrogenation plants that turn coal into oil, easing the dependence on imported fuel.
focus_desc.deu_tech_mobilization: Tie university and industry engineers to state research programmes to speed up weapons development.
focus_desc.deu_transition: The army's provisional government restores order and eases tensions abroad, stepping out of the old regime's alliances.
focus_desc.deu_tripartite: Prepare a treaty of mutual aid with Italy and Japan, meant also to keep the United States out of the war.
focus_desc.deu_uboats: Put scarce resources into U-boats and concentrate on cutting Britain's sea lanes.
focus_desc.deu_war_production: With war under way, switch the factories to war production and cut civilian consumption further.
focus_desc.deu_wehrmacht: Use the conscription restored in 1935 to grow the army quickly toward 36 divisions.
focus_desc.deu_western_reconciliation: Negotiate non-aggression with Britain and France and lower trade barriers, putting the bitterness of Versailles behind.
focus_desc.deu_westwall: Build bunkers and tank obstacles along the western border from the Netherlands to Switzerland.
focus_desc.fra_air_force_plan: A new air plan sets a target of thousands of front-line aircraft and adds the factories and airfields to match.
focus_desc.fra_alpine_troops: Mountain battalions are trained and equipped to fight on the passes facing Italy.
focus_desc.fra_armoured_corps: Heavy tanks are gathered into armoured divisions instead of being spread among the infantry. Colonel Charles de Gaulle, who argued for it, gets a command.
focus_desc.fra_arms_nationalisation: The state takes over the main private arms works, so that weapons are made for the nation rather than for profit.
focus_desc.fra_army_of_africa: The North African corps gets workshops and depots of its own, so that it can fight without waiting for convoys from France.
focus_desc.fra_army_reorganisation: Infantry divisions receive more anti-tank guns and engineers, and new manuals draw on the lessons of recent exercises.
focus_desc.fra_aviation_reorganisation: Scattered aircraft firms are merged into large national companies by region, with new plants and modern tooling.
focus_desc.fra_bomber_force: Light and medium bomber squadrons are formed to strike enemy columns and supply lines behind the front.
focus_desc.fra_colonial_divisions: Recruiting in North and West Africa is widened, and the new regiments are formed into full divisions.
focus_desc.fra_colonial_minerals: Rubber plantations in Indochina and mines across the colonies are expanded to keep the factories at home supplied.
focus_desc.fra_early_rearmament: Arms orders come before consumer spending, and the factories turn to war work years earlier than planned.
focus_desc.fra_eastern_alliances: France confirms its promises to Prague and Warsaw and seeks a real military understanding with Moscow.
focus_desc.fra_economic_recovery: Decree laws lengthen the working week and loosen the controls of 1936 to bring capital home and restart production.
focus_desc.fra_empire_defence: Garrisons in Africa and Asia receive new forts and fresh recruits raised in the colonies themselves.
focus_desc.fra_fast_battleships: Fast battleships with heavy guns are laid down to answer the new German and Italian ships.
focus_desc.fra_free_french_forces: Soldiers who reached Britain from Dunkirk and Norway, and volunteers from the colonies, are formed into new divisions.
focus_desc.fra_heavy_water: Military intelligence borrows Norway's whole stock of heavy water and brings it to the physicists of the Collège de France.
focus_desc.fra_indochina_defence: Coastal batteries, border posts and an airfield strengthen the colony against an attack from the north or the sea.
focus_desc.fra_industrial_survey: Engineers list every plant, machine and skilled worker that could be turned to defence work.
focus_desc.fra_june_appeal: From a London studio, General Charles de Gaulle tells the French that the war is not lost and calls on them to fight on.
focus_desc.fra_latin_bloc: Paris turns to Rome, Burgos and Lisbon for a bloc of Latin states standing between Germany and the Soviet Union.
focus_desc.fra_leagues_in_government: Leaders of the right-wing leagues are given ministries, and the left warns that the Republic itself is now at stake.
focus_desc.fra_levant_bases: Harbours in Syria and Lebanon are deepened and their airfields enlarged to guard the sea lanes of the eastern Mediterranean.
focus_desc.fra_liberation_government: Free France becomes the Provisional Government of the French Republic, ready to take charge of the liberated country.
focus_desc.fra_maginot_extension: Concrete casemates and anti-tank obstacles are carried along the Belgian frontier towards the sea.
focus_desc.fra_mers_el_kebir_base: A deep-water base is built near Oran to shelter the battle squadron on the African shore.
focus_desc.fra_ministry_of_armament: A single ministry takes charge of all arms production, from raw materials to the finished shell.
focus_desc.fra_mobile_reserve: Rather than pour more concrete, the army keeps motorised reserves behind the front to strike wherever the enemy breaks through.
focus_desc.fra_mobilisation_readiness: Call-up lists, depots and railway timetables are brought up to date so that the reserves can be called at short notice.
focus_desc.fra_modern_fighters: Designers are pressed to bring faster monoplane fighters from prototype to squadron service.
focus_desc.fra_motorised_divisions: Several infantry divisions trade their horses for lorries so that they can keep pace with the tanks.
focus_desc.fra_national_union: Instead of a left-wing coalition, Paul Reynaud gathers the centre and the moderate right around rearmament and a firm foreign policy.
focus_desc.fra_neutral_france: France leaves its old alliances and declares that it will defend its own soil and empire and nothing more.
focus_desc.fra_no_munich: The cabinet decides that it will not hand Czechoslovak territory to Germany, whatever London chooses.
focus_desc.fra_non_intervention: Paris proposes that no power send arms to either side in Spain, keeping London close and France out of the war.
focus_desc.fra_northern_industry: The coal and steel of the mines and mills of the Nord and Lorraine go first to military contracts.
focus_desc.fra_popular_front: The left-wing alliance that won the election forms a cabinet and ends the wave of strikes through talks between employers and unions.
focus_desc.fra_rally_the_empire: Envoys of Free France fly to Africa to win over governors and garrisons.
focus_desc.fra_rearmament_plan: A programme of billions of francs spread over four years pays for new tanks, guns and fortifications.
focus_desc.fra_research_centre: State laboratories are brought together under one national centre that hands out funds and sets research priorities.
focus_desc.fra_resistance_council: The resistance movements, parties and unions of occupied France unite in one council that recognises London.
focus_desc.fra_southwest_dispersal: Factories within reach of German bombers move to Toulouse, Bordeaux and the valleys of the southwest.
focus_desc.fra_strong_executive: Weary of short-lived cabinets, the government asks for the power to rule by decree and sets a deadlocked parliament aside.
focus_desc.fra_submarine_fleet: Large submarines able to cross oceans are ordered to strike enemy sea lanes in the Atlantic and the Mediterranean.
focus_desc.fra_tank_programme: Firm orders and a delivery schedule let the makers of heavy and cavalry tanks build in larger batches.
focus_desc.fra_war_government: With German troops at the frontier, the parties set their quarrels aside and serve together in one wartime cabinet.
focus_desc.gbr_air_training_plan: Tens of thousands of pilots and aircrew from across the Commonwealth learn to fly under Canada's wide skies.
focus_desc.gbr_aircraft_production: New plants roll out Hurricane and Spitfire fighters in growing numbers.
focus_desc.gbr_appeasement: To spare Europe another great war, London meets some German and Italian demands at the conference table and buys time to rearm.
focus_desc.gbr_armoured_division: Tank brigades and motorised infantry are combined into armoured divisions able to fight on their own.
focus_desc.gbr_atlantic_bridge: Closer ties with the United States open the way to borrowing American weapons and ships.
focus_desc.gbr_bef: The force meant for the Continent is reorganised on new lines and its officer training overhauled.
focus_desc.gbr_bomber_command: Long-range bomber squadrons come under one command, ready to strike the enemy's industrial districts.
focus_desc.gbr_carriers: New carriers with armoured flight decks are designed and laid down.
focus_desc.gbr_clyde: The yards on Glasgow's River Clyde fill up with warship orders again.
focus_desc.gbr_collective_security: In the spirit of the League, Britain will stand with any victim of aggression and is willing to work even with Moscow.
focus_desc.gbr_commandos: Small raiding forces for enemy coasts and the first parachute troops are trained.
focus_desc.gbr_convoy_system: Merchant ships will sail in escorted groups, and the system is prepared before the first shot.
focus_desc.gbr_crown_and_cabinet: Under the new King, Palace and government speak with one voice again and win back the confidence the abdication shook.
focus_desc.gbr_defence_white_paper: The 1936 Defence White Paper admits how far the three services have fallen behind and lays out a rearmament budget for the years ahead.
focus_desc.gbr_desert_training: Units in Egypt's Western Desert practise movement, supply and navigation on open sand.
focus_desc.gbr_dominion_call: Canada, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa and India send men and open their factories to the Empire's war.
focus_desc.gbr_empire_resources: Malayan rubber and mines across the Empire are tied into the home war economy.
focus_desc.gbr_fighter_command: Fighter Command takes charge of home air defence and directs its squadrons from the ground.
focus_desc.gbr_fleet_air_arm: The Navy takes its shipborne aircraft back from the RAF and runs them itself.
focus_desc.gbr_guarantees: Britain pledges to defend the countries Germany is likely to threaten next. An aggressor must now reckon with war against Britain.
focus_desc.gbr_home_fleet: New ships join the Home Fleet, which guards the North Sea from Scapa Flow.
focus_desc.gbr_imperial_conference: The Dominion prime ministers meet in London to settle the Empire's trade and defence together.
focus_desc.gbr_imperial_defence_council: The Dominions sign a joint defence plan to make arms together and enlarge their own forces.
focus_desc.gbr_imperial_preference: Low tariffs on trade inside the Empire bind the industries of Britain and the Dominions together.
focus_desc.gbr_india_defence: The Indian Army is modernised, and Indian factories begin making its weapons.
focus_desc.gbr_industrial_reorganisation: Depression-worn industrial districts are rationalised and investment is steered into modern plants.
focus_desc.gbr_labour_partnership: Bringing Labour into government wins over the trade unions and sets the state on the road to a planned economy.
focus_desc.gbr_mechanisation: Horses give way to lorries and carriers until the whole Army moves on wheels and tracks.
focus_desc.gbr_mediterranean: Stronger defences at Gibraltar, Malta and in Egypt guard the sea road to the Suez Canal.
focus_desc.gbr_midlands: The engineering works of Birmingham and Coventry take on arms contracts.
focus_desc.gbr_ministry_of_supply: A single ministry takes over buying the Army's weapons and equipment, so contracts and production are handled in one place.
focus_desc.gbr_nationalisation: The state takes over coal, steel and the railways and directs their output to rearmament, to the fury of the owners.
focus_desc.gbr_one_empire: Britain and the Dominions resolve to fight as one nation, and men from every corner of the Empire join the forces.
focus_desc.gbr_peacetime_conscription: The Military Training Act calls up twenty-year-old men in time of peace, something Britain has never done before.
focus_desc.gbr_peoples_rearmament: Working people throw their weight behind rearmament, and the factories and recruiting offices fill up together.
focus_desc.gbr_radar_chain: Tall masts along the east coast pick up approaching aircraft long before they arrive.
focus_desc.gbr_raf_expansion: The Royal Air Force issues one expansion scheme after another, adding squadron after squadron.
focus_desc.gbr_rearm_now: The rule that rearmament must not disturb normal trade is dropped, and industry puts war orders first.
focus_desc.gbr_scientific_committee: A committee of scientists under Henry Tizard looks for new ways to defend Britain from the air.
focus_desc.gbr_shadow_factories: Motor manufacturers run state-funded twin plants in the Midlands, ready to turn out aero engines and airframes the moment war comes.
focus_desc.gbr_singapore: More batteries and forts go up around the Singapore naval base, the key to the Empire's defence in the Far East.
focus_desc.gbr_south_wales: Investment in the pits and steelworks of South Wales raises steel output.
focus_desc.gbr_soviet_agreement: Facing Germany as a common enemy, London sets ideology aside and agrees with Moscow that each will help the other.
focus_desc.gbr_tank_programme: Design and production of infantry tanks and cruiser tanks are pushed forward.
focus_desc.gbr_territorial_army: In spring 1939 the government decides to double the Territorial Army and calls for volunteers.
focus_desc.gbr_total_production: Every factory switches to war work, running shifts around the clock.
focus_desc.gbr_university_research: Laboratories at Cambridge, Oxford and Birmingham take on work for the armed services.
focus_desc.gbr_war_cabinet: Every party joins a wartime coalition, and the general election is put off until the war is won.
focus_desc.gen_air_bases: Paved runways, hangars and repair shops spread across the country, ready for a larger air force.
focus_desc.gen_air_force: The flying corps becomes a service of its own and buys its first modern fighters.
focus_desc.gen_army_artillery: New gun designs and modern fire control are ordered for the artillery, and gunners train more often.
focus_desc.gen_army_doctrine: Officers weigh the lessons of the last war against the new weapons and write down how to fight the next one.
focus_desc.gen_army_fort: Bunkers, ditches and obstacles rise where the most dangerous neighbour would strike first.
focus_desc.gen_army_infantry: Worn-out rifles and field gear give way to designs fit for the next war, and the support units get new equipment too.
focus_desc.gen_army_reform: The general staff redraws the army's organisation, retires tired commanders and promotes able officers.
focus_desc.gen_army_staff: A staff college teaches officers to plan operations and to move large formations without confusion.
focus_desc.gen_ind_civ_1: Cheap credit and tax relief draw new factories to the towns with the most room to grow.
focus_desc.gen_ind_civ_2: Planned districts with power, water and workers' housing let builders raise new plants faster.
focus_desc.gen_ind_infra: New highways and branch lines bind the provinces to the capital, its markets and its garrisons.
focus_desc.gen_ind_mil_1: State arsenals are founded so that rifles, shells and guns no longer have to be bought abroad.
focus_desc.gen_ind_mil_2: Larger arsenals and new trade schools train the skilled hands that modern weapons demand.
focus_desc.gen_ind_resources: Geologists chart new deposits, and the state lays roads so that mining companies can reach them.
focus_desc.gen_ind_survey: Inspectors visit every mill, mine and workshop to learn what the country can truly make and where money would do the most good.
focus_desc.gen_navy_coast: Gun batteries and minefields guard the harbours most exposed to an attack from the sea.
focus_desc.gen_navy_yards: The best harbour gets a new slipway, and the navy asks its designers for modern ships.
focus_desc.gen_pol_admin: Overlapping ministries are merged, procedures shortened and a career civil service is built.
focus_desc.gen_pol_claims: Lands lost in past wars return to the speeches, the schoolbooks and the general staff's maps.
focus_desc.gen_pol_com: Trade unions and workers' councils gain a voice, and the ideas of the left spread through the factories.
focus_desc.gen_pol_com_ally: The party seeks closer ties with Moscow and the international communist movement.
focus_desc.gen_pol_defence_spirit: Newsreels, air-raid drills and veterans' leagues remind citizens that peace has to be guarded.
focus_desc.gen_pol_dem: Parliament, a free press and fair elections are held up as the source of the nation's strength.
focus_desc.gen_pol_dem_ally: Envoys visit the leading democracies to ask how the country might enter their alliance.
focus_desc.gen_pol_fas: A mass movement calls for order and national revival under a single disciplined party.
focus_desc.gen_pol_fas_ally: The government sends envoys to Berlin to ask whether a smaller state might enter its bloc.
focus_desc.gen_pol_neu: The government formally declares that it will take no side in the quarrels of the great powers.
focus_desc.gen_pol_neu_league: Neighbours who fear the great powers are invited into a defensive entente of our own.
focus_desc.gen_pol_unity: In a hard decade, rival parties and regions are asked to set their quarrels aside and pull together.
focus_desc.gen_rs_1: University grants and a national research council let the country pursue one more line of research.
focus_desc.gen_rs_2: Company laboratories work alongside the universities, and the state pays for both.
focus_desc.ita_albanian_question: Albania already lives on Italian loans and advisers. The army draws up plans to take the country outright.
focus_desc.ita_alpine_claims: With France at war or already beaten, Rome presses its old claims to Nice and Corsica.
focus_desc.ita_alpine_hydro: Italy has little coal but many mountain rivers. New dams send power to the northern factories.
focus_desc.ita_alpine_wall: Bunkers are dug and roads blocked along the mountain frontier with France, Switzerland and Yugoslavia.
focus_desc.ita_alpini: The Alpini, recruited in the mountain valleys, are among Italy's best-trained infantry. More divisions are formed.
focus_desc.ita_anti_comintern_pact: Italy joins the pact against the Communist International that Germany and Japan signed a year earlier.
focus_desc.ita_armed_neutrality: Italy keeps out of both camps and makes any attack on it costly, starting with the Alpine passes.
focus_desc.ita_armoured_divisions: Tank brigades grow into armoured divisions; the Ariete and the Centauro are formed in 1939.
focus_desc.ita_army_reform: General Pariani's plan for divisions of two regiments instead of three promises a lighter, faster army.
focus_desc.ita_autarky: The League's sanctions showed how much Italy imports. Mines, substitutes and home industry are to close the gap.
focus_desc.ita_axis_alignment: Sanctions have soured relations with London and Paris. Closer ties with Germany promise a free hand in the Mediterranean.
focus_desc.ita_axis_war_economy: Coal, raw materials and machine tools are shared out with Germany, and civilian goods give way to war output.
focus_desc.ita_balkan_sphere: Rome still claims the Dalmatian coast promised to it in 1915. Hungary and Bulgaria share its dislike of Yugoslavia.
focus_desc.ita_battleship_programme: The Littorio and the Vittorio Veneto, laid down in 1934, are pushed toward completion.
focus_desc.ita_brenner_watch: In 1934 Italian divisions moved to the Brenner Pass to warn Germany away from Austria. The frontier is strengthened again.
focus_desc.ita_carrier_project: The admirals long held that the peninsula itself was a carrier. A converted liner could give the fleet aircraft of its own.
focus_desc.ita_constitutional_restoration: Parties are allowed again, and the Chamber is freely elected under the kingdom's old constitution, the Statuto.
focus_desc.ita_crown_council: The King gathers marshals and senators who distrust the drift toward Berlin.
focus_desc.ita_desert_doctrine: Fighting in Libya teaches officers to move by compass, carry their own water and strike across open sand.
focus_desc.ita_dodecanese_bases: Rhodes and Leros, Italian since 1912, lie on the way into the Aegean. They are fitted out as naval and air bases.
focus_desc.ita_empire_consolidation: With the Ethiopian war ending, Rome turns to its debts, its garrisons and order at home.
focus_desc.ita_fighter_modernisation: Biplanes and early monoplanes give way to fighters such as the Macchi C.202, powered by a licence-built German engine.
focus_desc.ita_grand_council_check: Members of the Fascist Grand Council fear being dragged into Germany's wars and could vote to curb Mussolini's powers.
focus_desc.ita_iri_reorganisation: The Institute for Industrial Reconstruction, set up in 1933 to rescue failing banks, becomes a permanent state holding in 1937.
focus_desc.ita_istrian_bauxite: The bauxite of Istria can supply the aluminium the aircraft factories need.
focus_desc.ita_leave_league: The League that punished Italy over Ethiopia has nothing more to offer Rome. Italy gives notice that it is leaving.
focus_desc.ita_libyan_road: A road along the whole Libyan coast, opened in 1937, links the Tunisian border with the Egyptian one.
focus_desc.ita_mare_nostrum: The navy argues that Italy's fate will be decided at sea. Slipways and naval research come first.
focus_desc.ita_motor_industry: Fiat, Lancia and Alfa Romeo are asked for trucks and tank designs instead of cars.
focus_desc.ita_motorised_divisions: Trucked infantry divisions such as the Trento and the Trieste are meant to keep pace with the tanks.
focus_desc.ita_non_belligerence: Germany is at war, but Italy's army and stockpiles are not ready. Rome declares itself neither neutral nor at war.
focus_desc.ita_northern_arsenal: Most of Italy's heavy industry lies around Turin, Milan and Genoa. New arms works go up in the Po valley.
focus_desc.ita_parallel_war: Rome means to fight its own war beside Germany's, for its own aims in the Balkans and Africa.
focus_desc.ita_regia_aeronautica: The air force that set flying records in the 1930s needs modern types and spare parts for a long war.
focus_desc.ita_research_council: The National Research Council, long chaired by Marconi, steers universities and laboratories toward the state's needs.
focus_desc.ita_sicilian_narrows: Between Sicily and Tunisia the sea narrows to about 150 km. Batteries on Sicily and Pantelleria can close it.
focus_desc.ita_spain_expedition: Franco's Nationalists ask Rome for help. A corps of Italian volunteers can be raised and shipped across.
focus_desc.ita_steel_pact: Ciano and the German foreign minister draft a full alliance that binds each country to join the other's wars.
focus_desc.ita_stresa_revival: In 1935 Italy, Britain and France agreed at Stresa to stand together against German rearmament. Rome could return to that line.
focus_desc.ita_submarine_arm: Italy already has one of the largest submarine fleets in the world. Newer boats and trained crews are added.
focus_desc.ita_suez_question: At war with Britain, the army in Libya can strike east into Egypt and toward the canal.
focus_desc.ita_synthetic_fuel: ANIC, a state company founded in 1936, builds hydrogenation refineries at Bari and Livorno.
focus_desc.ita_torpedo_bombers: SM.79 bombers fitted with torpedoes form the first aerial torpedo squadrons in 1940.
focus_desc.ita_tripartite_entry: In Berlin, Germany, Italy and Japan sign a pact recognising each other's spheres in Europe and East Asia.
focus_desc.ita_war_booty: Repair teams follow the front to put captured trucks, guns and fuel back into service.
focus_desc.ita_western_reconciliation: A government without Mussolini can step back from Berlin and offer London and Paris pacts of non-aggression.
focus_desc.jpn_after_february: Punish the mutinous officers and seat a new cabinet to calm the capital. In return, the army wants a larger share of power.
focus_desc.jpn_aircraft_industry: Steer military orders to the private aircraft makers and expand their airframe and engine plants.
focus_desc.jpn_anti_comintern_pact: Sign a pact with Germany against the Communist International, with a secret annex aimed at the Soviet Union.
focus_desc.jpn_army_air_service: Expand the fighter and bomber units that support the land fronts on the continent, and their airfields.
focus_desc.jpn_army_modernisation: Replace infantry weapons and guns with newer models and rework outdated formations and training.
focus_desc.jpn_army_navy_accord: The army and navy, long at odds over budgets and policy, agree how to share operations and resources.
focus_desc.jpn_battleship_priority: Believing big-gun battleships will decide the decisive battle, put battleship construction first.
focus_desc.jpn_captured_arms: Repair the enemy weapons and vehicles taken in battle and issue them to units that are short of equipment.
focus_desc.jpn_carrier_strike_force: Bring the carriers together into one force and learn to strike enemy fleets from long range with their aircraft.
focus_desc.jpn_china_settlement: End the fighting with China and withdraw from the occupied areas, seeking economic rights at the table instead.
focus_desc.jpn_cooperative_diplomacy: Return to a diplomacy that guards Japan's interests inside the treaty order built with Britain and America.
focus_desc.jpn_fuel_reserve: Fill storage tanks with oil for the navy and army ahead of time, buying time should imports stop.
focus_desc.jpn_garrison_units: Raise more garrison units to guard railways and towns in occupied areas, freeing field divisions for the front.
focus_desc.jpn_hardline_cabinet: The cabinet that kept negotiating resigns and a serving general becomes prime minister. A deadline is set: if diplomacy fails, war.
focus_desc.jpn_hawaii_operation: A plan to strike the US Pacific Fleet at Hawaii with carriers first and so guard the flank of the southern campaign.
focus_desc.jpn_heavy_industry: Pour capital and materials into steel, machinery and chemicals to widen the heavy industry that arms production rests on.
focus_desc.jpn_indochina_bases: With France fallen, demand the use of the airfields and ports of French Indochina.
focus_desc.jpn_jungle_training: Study fighting in hot, wet forest and swamp, and train to move on little supply.
focus_desc.jpn_kwantung_reinforcement: Build forts along the border between Manchukuo and the Soviet Union and give the Kwantung Army more men and equipment.
focus_desc.jpn_leave_axis: Wind down the commitments to Germany one by one and choose a course that keeps Japan out of Europe's war.
focus_desc.jpn_manchukuo_industry: A five-year plan led by Japanese capital and officials develops Manchukuo's coal and steel, leaving Manchukuo even less say.
focus_desc.jpn_military_ministers: Restore the rule that only serving generals and admirals may be army and navy ministers. No cabinet can stand if the services refuse to name one.
focus_desc.jpn_mongol_government: Set up a military government in Inner Mongolia under local Mongol princes, with the Kwantung Army behind it.
focus_desc.jpn_nanjing_regime: Join with Nationalist figures who broke with Chongqing to set up a government in Nanjing over the occupied areas.
focus_desc.jpn_naval_air_arm: Add carrier and land-based attack aircraft and widen the training of naval pilots for war at sea.
focus_desc.jpn_naval_expansion: With the naval treaties lapsed, draw up replenishment plans for new battleships and carriers.
focus_desc.jpn_naval_landing_force: Expand and train the navy's own landing troops so that islands and coasts can be seized quickly.
focus_desc.jpn_new_order: A movement to dissolve the parties and fold every association into one national organisation takes hold of the cabinet.
focus_desc.jpn_night_tactics: Infantry short of firepower trains to close with the enemy under cover of darkness.
focus_desc.jpn_north_china_question: Efforts to pry northern China away from the Nationalist government go on. The army is ready for a wider clash.
focus_desc.jpn_outer_perimeter: As the front gives way, redraw the islands and waters to be held and fortify the mandated islands.
focus_desc.jpn_pacific_partnership: Pledge non-aggression with America and Britain and build a framework of cooperation among the Pacific nations.
focus_desc.jpn_parliamentary_government: Entrench the practice of cabinets answering to the Diet. The services lose their veto over who governs.
focus_desc.jpn_party_cabinet: Hand the cabinet back to the majority in the Diet. The army bristles, but party politics gets a second wind.
focus_desc.jpn_radio_weapons: Hurry research into finding the enemy by radio waves — already behind Britain and America.
focus_desc.jpn_science_mobilisation: Gather the scientists of universities and institutes around national research programmes and link military and civilian work.
focus_desc.jpn_shipbuilding: Add slipways at the navy yards and private shipyards so that several large ships can be built at once.
focus_desc.jpn_soviet_neutrality_talks: To go south, the north must stay quiet. Send the foreign minister to Moscow to negotiate a neutrality pact.
focus_desc.jpn_strike_north: Following the northern school, prepare the Kwantung Army for a campaign against the Soviet Far East.
focus_desc.jpn_strike_south: Make the southern school national policy, turn towards the oil and rubber of Southeast Asia and hurry the navy's preparations.
focus_desc.jpn_submarine_fleet: Form flotillas of large submarines to shadow the enemy fleet and wear it down before the decisive battle.
focus_desc.jpn_synthetic_oil: Build plants that draw fuel from coal and encourage their output, so the country leans less on imported oil.
focus_desc.jpn_tank_corps: Gather the tank regiments scattered among the infantry into tank divisions with mobile infantry and artillery.
focus_desc.jpn_tripartite: Ally with Germany and Italy: if a power not yet at war attacks one of the three, the others stand with it. The pledge is aimed at America.
focus_desc.jpn_unified_war_administration: Merge scattered ministries and control boards so that the whole war effort answers to one chain of command under the cabinet.
focus_desc.jpn_wartime_mobilisation: As the war drags on, materials, capital and factories come under government plans. Civilian consumption shrinks and arms come first.
focus_desc.sun_academy: Give the Academy, recently moved to Moscow, the institutes and funds to serve industry.
focus_desc.sun_allied_cooperation: Sign aid agreements with Britain and the United States and open a supply route through Iran.
focus_desc.sun_antifascist_front: Openly back threatened neighbors and seek treaties with every government willing to resist Germany.
focus_desc.sun_army_reformers: Leave the officer corps intact and let the commanders who developed deep operations reshape the Red Army.
focus_desc.sun_baku: Drill new wells around Baku and across the Caspian to fuel tractors, tanks and aircraft.
focus_desc.sun_china_treaty: Offer the Nationalist government a non-aggression pact, with Soviet arms to follow.
focus_desc.sun_collective_leadership: Decisions return to the Politburo as a body, and no single man stands above the party.
focus_desc.sun_collective_security: Honor the 1935 mutual assistance pacts with France and Czechoslovakia and stand against aggressors in the League.
focus_desc.sun_comintern_aid: Ship rifles and ammunition to the Spanish Republic and the Chinese communists while courting the government in Nanjing.
focus_desc.sun_commander_rebuild: Release and reinstate surviving officers arrested in the purge, and promote proven younger commanders.
focus_desc.sun_deep_battle: Write the theory of striking the enemy's entire depth at once into the 1936 field regulations.
focus_desc.sun_design_bureaus: Organize engineers into design bureaus, each taking a weapon from the drawing board to the factory.
focus_desc.sun_dnieper_power: Connect the Dnieper hydroelectric station to a grid that feeds the factories of the south.
focus_desc.sun_donbas: Modernize the mines and mills of the Donets Basin, the oldest industrial region of the Union.
focus_desc.sun_evacuation: Load whole plants onto trains and rebuild them in the Urals before the front reaches them.
focus_desc.sun_far_east_army: Reinforce the Special Red Banner Far Eastern Army and fortify the long border with Manchukuo.
focus_desc.sun_finland_demands: Leningrad lies within artillery range of the Finnish border. Ask Helsinki to move the border back in exchange for land further north.
focus_desc.sun_german_treaty: Talks with Berlin, on trade first and then on politics, could keep the Soviet Union out of a European war for now.
focus_desc.sun_great_purge: Party, state and army are searched for "enemies of the people". Power gathers at the top while fear spreads below.
focus_desc.sun_ground_attack: Develop an armored aircraft that flies low over the battlefield and supports the infantry directly.
focus_desc.sun_guards: Divisions that distinguish themselves in battle earn the Guards title, higher pay and better equipment.
focus_desc.sun_japan_neutrality: Offer Tokyo a neutrality pact so that the army can face west without worrying about the Far East.
focus_desc.sun_magnitogorsk: Add blast furnaces to the steel city built on the iron ore of Magnitnaya Mountain.
focus_desc.sun_manchurian_plan: With the war in Europe decided, the General Staff plans an offensive against the Kwantung Army in Manchuria.
focus_desc.sun_mass_mobilisation: Call up every age class the law allows and form new divisions as fast as they can be armed.
focus_desc.sun_mech_corps: Combine tank brigades into mechanized corps that can break through and drive deep.
focus_desc.sun_moderate_economy: Slow the pace of heavy industry, ease the burden on the countryside and put more goods in the shops.
focus_desc.sun_mongolia_defence: Under the 1936 mutual assistance protocol, Soviet troops and engineers move into Mongolia.
focus_desc.sun_new_border_forts: Begin fortified districts along the border that moved west in 1939 and 1940.
focus_desc.sun_new_constitution: The Congress of Soviets adopts the 1936 Constitution, promising universal suffrage and a long list of civil rights.
focus_desc.sun_new_course: After Munich, faith in London and Paris has worn thin. The foreign commissariat gets new leadership and a freer hand.
focus_desc.sun_ocean_fleet: Lay down battleships and cruisers in the Leningrad and Black Sea yards for a fleet worthy of a great power.
focus_desc.sun_patriotic_war: The country fights for its survival. Every factory, farm and family is called to the defense of the homeland.
focus_desc.sun_purge_ends: Mass arrests are halted and some cases reopened, but the posts the purge emptied will take years to fill.
focus_desc.sun_railways: Add a second track to the Trans-Siberian and finish the lines the five-year plans left incomplete.
focus_desc.sun_red_air_force: Order fighters by the hundred and set the design bureaus to work on faster aircraft.
focus_desc.sun_rkka_expansion: Convert territorial militia divisions into a standing cadre army and train more rifle divisions.
focus_desc.sun_second_fyp: Finish the last construction projects of the plan begun in 1933 on schedule and bring the new plants into production.
focus_desc.sun_spheres: The secret protocol places Finland, the Baltic states and Bessarabia in the Soviet sphere. Moscow prepares its demands.
focus_desc.sun_stakhanov: Since Alexei Stakhanov's record shift in 1935, record-breaking workers are held up as examples to all.
focus_desc.sun_stalin_line: Add bunkers and garrisons to the fortified districts along the old western border.
focus_desc.sun_submarines: Build the largest submarine force in the world to guard the approaches to Soviet ports.
focus_desc.sun_tank_works: Turn the locomotive and tractor plants of Kharkiv, Leningrad and Chelyabinsk over to tank production.
focus_desc.sun_third_fyp: The new plan puts the defense industry first and builds up production east of the Volga.
focus_desc.sun_ural_base: Build a second industrial heartland in the Urals, far from every border.
focus_desc.sun_western_alliance: Press London and Paris for a binding military pact and pledge to defend Poland and Romania.
focus_desc.sun_winter_war_lessons: The costly war in Finland is studied without illusions, and training, ranks and command are overhauled.
focus_desc.usa_air_corps: The Army Air Corps orders thousands of new aircraft and opens schools to train their crews.
focus_desc.usa_airborne: A test platoon of parachutists grows into whole divisions trained to drop behind enemy lines.
focus_desc.usa_america_first: The isolationists win the argument: America will arm itself but keep out of Europe's quarrels and guard its own hemisphere.
focus_desc.usa_armored_force: Tank units scattered between the infantry and the cavalry are gathered into one force with its own armored divisions.
focus_desc.usa_army_expansion: The small peacetime army begins to grow, with more regiments and a leaner, faster infantry division.
focus_desc.usa_arsenal_of_democracy: The President tells the nation that America must become the great arsenal of democracy for those who fight aggression.
focus_desc.usa_bases_deal: Old destroyers go to Britain, and in return America leases bases from Newfoundland to the Caribbean.
focus_desc.usa_cash_and_carry: The Neutrality Act of 1939 lets nations at war buy American arms if they pay in cash and carry them home in their own ships.
focus_desc.usa_china_aid: Rifles and trucks travel the Burma Road to China, and American pilots volunteer to fly for its air force.
focus_desc.usa_defense_research: Scientists from the universities and industry are organised to develop new weapons under government contracts.
focus_desc.usa_detroit_arsenal: Car plants around the Great Lakes retool to build tanks, engines and bombers.
focus_desc.usa_escort_fighters: Drop tanks and new fighters let the escorts stay with the bombers all the way to the target and back.
focus_desc.usa_europe_first: Staff talks with Britain settle it: Germany is the main enemy, and the Pacific must hold while Europe is decided.
focus_desc.usa_fast_carriers: New fast aircraft carriers become the heart of the fleet, with battleships as their escorts.
focus_desc.usa_good_neighbor: Washington renounces armed intervention in Latin America and looks for partners instead of protectorates.
focus_desc.usa_hemisphere_defence: The Panama Canal and the Caribbean approaches become the outer wall of a fortress that spans the Americas.
focus_desc.usa_iceland_garrison: American troops take over the defence of Iceland from the British and keep the North Atlantic route open.
focus_desc.usa_industrial_mobilisation: War Department planners set out how the factories will switch to arms if war comes.
focus_desc.usa_internationalism: The State Department argues that America cannot stay safe while aggressors redraw the map, and Washington leans toward London and Paris.
focus_desc.usa_lend_lease_bill: A bill lets the President lend or lease war materials to any country whose defence is vital to the United States.
focus_desc.usa_louisiana_maneuvers: Hundreds of thousands of soldiers fight mock battles across the South; many officers are tested and some are replaced.
focus_desc.usa_marine_corps: The Marines refine their landing doctrine and grow into divisions made for a war among islands.
focus_desc.usa_motor_pool: Trucks and jeeps replace horses, and every infantry division can move on wheels.
focus_desc.usa_naval_expansion: Congress pays for new warships to bring the fleet up to the limits of the naval treaties.
focus_desc.usa_neutral_trade: American merchants sell to every buyer who pays, while the government keeps out of foreign quarrels.
focus_desc.usa_neutrality_patrol: American warships patrol a security zone off the coasts of the Americas and report every ship they meet.
focus_desc.usa_pacific_first: The Navy wins the argument: Japan must be beaten first, and the fleet and the Marines get the largest share.
focus_desc.usa_pan_american_pact: Washington proposes a common defence: an attack on one American republic will be treated as an attack on all of them.
focus_desc.usa_pearl_harbor_base: Dry docks, fuel tanks and airfields on Oahu turn Pearl Harbor into the fleet's forward base.
focus_desc.usa_philippine_defence: Forts at the mouth of Manila Bay and new airfields are to hold the islands until the fleet can arrive.
focus_desc.usa_philippine_independence: The Commonwealth of the Philippines takes charge of its own affairs ahead of the independence promised by law.
focus_desc.usa_preparedness: As the world grows more dangerous, the government quietly places its first large orders for arms and aircraft.
focus_desc.usa_radiation_lab: A new laboratory at MIT takes up microwave radar, building on a device shared by British scientists.
focus_desc.usa_recession_response: Budget cuts in 1937 send the economy back into a slump. Washington turns to public spending again to restart the recovery.
focus_desc.usa_second_new_deal: Relief gives way to reform: new laws on labour, banking and public works aim to put the recovery on a lasting footing.
focus_desc.usa_selective_service: The Selective Training and Service Act of 1940 brings the first peacetime draft in American history.
focus_desc.usa_social_security: The Social Security Act of 1935 sets up old-age pensions and unemployment insurance, a floor under working families.
focus_desc.usa_standard_freighters: Simple cargo ships of a single standard design are welded together in weeks instead of months.
focus_desc.usa_strategic_bombing: Air Corps theorists hold that heavy bombers flying by day can hit factories precisely and break an enemy's industry.
focus_desc.usa_submarine_campaign: Submarines are ordered to sink Japanese merchant ships wherever they find them and cut Japan's sea lanes.
focus_desc.usa_synthetic_rubber: With Asia's rubber plantations at risk, chemists and oil companies build plants that make rubber from petroleum.
focus_desc.usa_texas_oil: New wells and pipelines raise output in Texas, and the crude flows to the refineries on the coast.
focus_desc.usa_tva: The Tennessee Valley Authority builds dams that stop floods and bring cheap electricity to one of the poorest regions.
focus_desc.usa_two_ocean_coast: Coastal batteries and new shipyards guard the Atlantic and Pacific seaboards against any raid from the sea.
focus_desc.usa_two_ocean_navy: After the fall of France, Congress orders a fleet large enough to fight in the Atlantic and the Pacific at once.
focus_desc.usa_war_production_board: One board now allocates steel, rubber and machine tools and turns peacetime industry over to war orders.

news.deu_news_coup: German army officers have seized power in Berlin.
news.deu_news_july_plot: Officers in Germany have toppled the regime and set up a provisional government.
news.deu_news_tripartite: The Tripartite Pact is signed in Berlin.
news.esp_civil_war: An army rising splits Spain: civil war between the Republic and the Nationalists.
news.fin_winter_war_flag: Soviet troops cross into Finland: the Winter War begins.
news.gen_exile_formed: A defeated government escapes abroad and fights on in exile.
news.gen_peace_conference: A peace conference opens to settle the end of a war.
news.gen_uprising: An uprising breaks out in an occupied region.
news.gen_volunteers_arrive: Foreign volunteers arrive to join the fighting.
news.ita_albania: Italy invades Albania; King Zog flees the country.
news.ita_news_alpine_armistice: France and Italy have signed an armistice; Italy holds a zone along the Alpine frontier.
news.ita_news_armistice: Italy has announced an armistice with the Allies and left the war.
news.ita_news_cobelligerence: Italy has declared war on Germany and fights on as a co-belligerent of the Allies.
news.ita_news_grand_council: The King of Italy has dismissed and arrested Mussolini; a marshal heads the new government.
news.ita_news_restrained: Italy's Grand Council has curbed Mussolini's powers; a marshal now heads the government in Rome.
news.jpn_marco_polo_bridge: Fighting at the Marco Polo Bridge grows into war between Japan and China.
news.jpn_surrender_effect: Japan has accepted the Potsdam Declaration and surrendered.
news.news_addis_ababa: Italian troops enter Addis Ababa; Italy proclaims an empire in East Africa.
news.news_anschluss: German troops enter Austria, and Austria is joined to the German Reich.
news.news_baltics: A Baltic state is annexed by the Soviet Union after an ultimatum.
news.news_belgrade_coup: Coup in Belgrade: Yugoslavia's new government turns away from the Axis.
news.news_bessarabia: Romania cedes Bessarabia and northern Bukovina to the Soviet Union.
news.news_casablanca: At Casablanca, the Allies declare they will accept only unconditional surrender.
news.news_civil_war: Civil war has broken out in {tag}
news.news_croatian_state: An Independent State of Croatia is proclaimed in Zagreb under Axis protection.
news.news_danzig: The Free City of Danzig is joined to Germany.
news.news_denmark_takeover: Germany ends its cooperation with the Danish government and imposes direct rule.
news.news_dobruja: Treaty of Craiova: Romania returns Southern Dobruja to Bulgaria.
news.news_esp_civil_war_ends: The Spanish Civil War is over; one government now rules all of Spain.
news.news_ethiopia_restored: Emperor Haile Selassie returns to Addis Ababa; Ethiopia is restored.
news.news_exile_returned: The government of {tag} has returned home
news.news_exiled: The government of {tag} has gone into exile in {hostTag}
news.news_fatherland_front: The Fatherland Front takes power in Sofia; Bulgaria turns against Germany.
news.news_fra_free_french_africa: Chad, Cameroon and the French Congo rally to General de Gaulle.
news.news_fra_paris_uprising: Paris rises against its German garrison.
news.news_fra_vichy_dissolved: The Provisional Government declares the Vichy regime's acts void and takes over its last territories.
news.news_gbr_abdication: King Edward VIII of Britain abdicates; his brother becomes King George VI.
news.news_gbr_anglo_soviet: Britain and the Soviet Union sign an agreement to fight Germany together.
news.news_gbr_churchill: Winston Churchill becomes Prime Minister of Britain.
news.news_gbr_election_1945: Labour wins Britain's general election by a landslide; Clement Attlee becomes Prime Minister.
news.news_golden_square: A military coup in Baghdad brings a pro-Axis government to power in Iraq.
news.news_greek_thrace: Bulgaria annexes eastern Macedonia and Western Thrace.
news.news_hatay: Hatay joins Turkey with French consent.
news.news_horthy_armistice: Regent Horthy announces on the radio that Hungary seeks an armistice.
news.news_hungary_coup: A German-backed coup in Budapest removes the Regent; Hungary stays in the war.
news.news_hungary_occupied: German troops occupy Hungary; the Regent stays in office under a pro-German cabinet.
news.news_iceland_occupied: British forces land in Iceland to keep the island out of German hands.
news.news_iceland_us_garrison: United States Marines arrive to garrison Iceland.
news.news_international_brigades: The first International Brigades form at Albacete to fight for the Spanish Republic.
news.news_iran_armistice: Iran orders a ceasefire; British and Soviet troops occupy the south and the north.
news.news_italy_occupied: German troops disarm the Italian army and occupy northern and central Italy.
news.news_memel: Lithuania returns the Memel Territory to Germany.
news.news_moscow_armistice: Finland signs an armistice with the Soviet Union and turns against the German troops in Lapland.
news.news_moscow_peace: The Moscow Peace ends the Winter War; Finland cedes Karelia.
news.news_mr_pact: Germany and the Soviet Union sign a non-aggression pact in Moscow.
news.news_munich: The Munich Agreement is signed: the Sudetenland passes to Germany.
news.news_new_shah: Reza Shah abdicates; his son Mohammad Reza Pahlavi becomes Shah of Iran.
news.news_pearl_harbor: Japanese carrier aircraft strike Pearl Harbor; the United States enters the war.
news.news_potsdam: At Potsdam, the Allies fix Germany's eastern border on the Oder-Neisse line.
news.news_prague: German troops enter Prague; Czechoslovakia ceases to exist.
news.news_romania_switches: A royal coup in Bucharest: Romania leaves the Axis and turns on Germany.
news.news_slovak_state: A Slovak state is proclaimed in Bratislava under German protection.
news.news_slovak_uprising: The Slovak National Uprising begins; German troops move into Slovakia.
news.news_social_republic: Mussolini heads an Italian Social Republic in German-held northern Italy.
news.news_takeover: {toTag} is now led by a new player in place of {fromTag}
news.news_tehran: At Tehran, the Allied leaders agree on a landing in France in 1944.
news.news_tokyo_peace: The Treaty of Tokyo ends the war between France and Siam; Siam regains its border provinces.
news.news_united_nations: Twenty-six nations sign the Declaration by United Nations in Washington.
news.news_vic_case_anton: German troops occupy southern France; Italian troops land on Corsica.
news.news_vic_dakar: Vichy's guns at Dakar drive off a British and Free French squadron.
news.news_vic_full_powers: The French parliament votes full powers; the Third Republic gives way to the French State.
news.news_vic_levant: Vichy's forces in Syria and Lebanon sign an armistice at Acre.
news.news_vic_madagascar: The last Vichy troops on Madagascar lay down their arms.
news.news_vic_mers_el_kebir: British warships open fire on the French fleet at Mers-el-Kébir.
news.news_vic_state: France signs an armistice; a French government at Vichy keeps the south and the empire.
news.news_vic_torch: French North and West Africa stop fighting the Allies and take up arms against Germany.
news.news_vic_toulon: The French fleet at Toulon scuttles itself before German troops can seize it.
news.news_vienna_award_1: First Vienna Award: southern Slovakia passes to Hungary.
news.news_vienna_award_2: Second Vienna Award: northern Transylvania passes to Hungary.
news.news_vilnius_to_lithuania: The Soviet Union hands Vilnius to Lithuania and stations troops in the country.
news.news_warsaw_uprising: The Polish Home Army rises against the German garrison in Warsaw.
news.news_yalta: At Yalta, the Allies settle the occupation of Germany; the Soviet Union pledges war on Japan.
news.news_yugoslavia_partition: Germany, Italy, Hungary and Bulgaria divide occupied Yugoslavia between them.
news.sun_poland: The Soviet Union invades Poland from the east

spirit.vic_state_regime: Regime of the Head of State

spirit_desc.chn_warlords: Provincial generals obey Nanjing only when it suits them.
spirit_desc.deu_combined_doctrine: Tanks and infantry, guns and aircraft move as one.
spirit_desc.deu_conscription_back: The conscription law of 1935 brings a fresh age class into the ranks every year.
spirit_desc.deu_fyp_economy: Raw-material self-sufficiency and arms output come before consumer goods.
spirit_desc.deu_generals_doubt: The army leadership does not trust the regime's plans for war.
spirit_desc.deu_highway_works: Building the motorways has trained construction crews and machinery.
spirit_desc.deu_rearmament: Since conscription returned in March 1935, arms plants come before consumer goods.
spirit_desc.deu_replacement_system: Regional replacement battalions quickly make good the losses at the front.
spirit_desc.deu_rhineland_dmz: The Versailles and Locarno treaties bar German troops and fortifications from the Rhineland.
spirit_desc.deu_standard_tools: Common standards let factories share their work.
spirit_desc.deu_tech_drive: University and industry engineers work on state research programmes.
spirit_desc.deu_war_academy: The War Academy, reopened in 1935, turns out trained staff officers.
spirit_desc.deu_wartime_output: The factories run day and night while civilian life grows leaner.
spirit_desc.esp_civil_war_nation: Spain has split in two, and every factory and village has had to choose a side.
spirit_desc.fra_armament_ministry: One ministry plans the production of arms from the mine to the front.
spirit_desc.fra_colonial_mines: New concessions and roads raise the output of the colonial mines.
spirit_desc.fra_colonial_troops: Regiments from Africa and Asia add to the reserves of the home army.
spirit_desc.fra_defensive_mind: The general staff trusts the Maginot Line and plans for a long defensive war.
spirit_desc.fra_defensive_mind_plus: The fortified line is longer than ever, and the army trusts it more than ever.
spirit_desc.fra_dispersed_factories: Plants spread across the south are harder for enemy bombers to find and to hit.
spirit_desc.fra_divided: Short-lived cabinets and street clashes between left and right shake every government.
spirit_desc.fra_divided_eased: The bitterness between left and right has eased a little, but cabinets still fall easily.
spirit_desc.fra_divided_half: Daladier's centrist cabinet has eased, but not ended, the quarrels of left and right.
spirit_desc.fra_forty_hours: Shorter hours and paid holidays have calmed the strikes but slowed the factories.
spirit_desc.fra_free_france: Every Frenchman who refuses the armistice has a place in the fight.
spirit_desc.fra_hard_line: The government will make no more concessions, though not everyone is ready to pay the price.
spirit_desc.fra_hollow_years: The thin age groups born during the Great War are now reaching call-up age.
spirit_desc.fra_matignon: Wage rises and collective agreements have restored social peace, but labour costs keep climbing.
spirit_desc.fra_mobile_doctrine: Motorised reserves and counter-attacks replace the long wait behind concrete.
spirit_desc.fra_neutrality: France threatens no one, and whoever seeks a quarrel will find her well defended.
spirit_desc.fra_nuclear_physics: French physicists lead the study of chain reactions in uranium.
spirit_desc.fra_parliament_crisis: Rule by decree gets things done but wears away trust in the regime.
spirit_desc.fra_rearm_first: Defence orders take precedence over goods for the shops.
spirit_desc.fra_rearmament_plan_spirit: Long-term arms orders let the military factories grow steadily.
spirit_desc.fra_sacred_union: As in 1914, the nation puts its divisions aside until the enemy is beaten.
spirit_desc.gbr_desert_warfare: Desert-trained units move and fight through heat and sand.
spirit_desc.gbr_empire: Dominions and colonies around the globe add manpower and political weight.
spirit_desc.gbr_empire_mines: Mines across the Empire feed raw materials to British factories.
spirit_desc.gbr_empire_trade: Low tariffs within the Empire bring in more goods for every trade deal.
spirit_desc.gbr_guarantee_pledge: Britain has publicly promised to defend small nations against aggression.
spirit_desc.gbr_kings_party: The King's supporters lead the government, but the constitutional crisis has divided the country.
spirit_desc.gbr_no_more_concessions: Since Prague the public agrees that Germany must be stood up to.
spirit_desc.gbr_peace_mood: Memories of the last war leave voters wary of rearmament and conscription.
spirit_desc.gbr_peace_policy: Careful diplomacy to avoid war reassures the public but also dulls its vigilance.
spirit_desc.gbr_planned_economy: The state plans investment and output, driving factory building while protecting living standards.
spirit_desc.gbr_rearm_programme: A rearmament budget spread over several years speeds up the building of military factories.
spirit_desc.gbr_security_pact: Britain is ready to guarantee threatened nations even before aggression begins.
spirit_desc.gbr_supply_ministry: One ministry now buys the Army's weapons, and production runs more smoothly.
spirit_desc.gbr_territorial_reserve: The doubled Territorial Army offers a deeper pool of recruits.
spirit_desc.gbr_total_output: Every factory keeps war production going day and night.
spirit_desc.gbr_united_empire: Men from across the Empire join the forces under the same flag as Britain.
spirit_desc.gbr_university_drive: University laboratories work for the armed services, speeding up research.
spirit_desc.gbr_war_coalition: All parties sit in one cabinet and share the responsibility for the war.
spirit_desc.gen_armed_neutrality: Neutrality backed by a ready army makes any would-be attacker hesitate.
spirit_desc.gen_arms_limit: A peace treaty caps our army at twelve divisions, forbids naval construction and halves the output of our arms factories.
spirit_desc.gen_civil_strife: The government changed after civil strife, but wrecked factories and a divided people remain.
spirit_desc.gen_democratic_movement: Civic leagues that stand for democracy keep winning new supporters.
spirit_desc.gen_efficient_government: A leaner administration gets more done with the same effort.
spirit_desc.gen_exile_no_elections: A government abroad cannot hold elections until it returns home.
spirit_desc.gen_industrial_subsidy_spirit: Subsidised builders put up civilian factories faster.
spirit_desc.gen_industrial_zone: Ready-made industrial zones let new buildings go up faster.
spirit_desc.gen_labour_movement: Unions and left-wing clubs widen support for communism step by step.
spirit_desc.gen_martial_law_spirit: Soldiers on the streets have restored order, but the factories have lost hands.
spirit_desc.gen_mining_drive: New mines and machinery bring more ore and oil out of the ground.
spirit_desc.gen_neutrality_declared: Our formal neutrality makes it slower for others to build a case for war against us.
spirit_desc.gen_non_intervention: We have pledged to send neither volunteers nor lend-lease to either side in Spain.
spirit_desc.gen_partisan_support_spirit: Airdrops and couriers keep the partisans fighting behind enemy lines in our occupied lands.
spirit_desc.gen_rally_spirit: While the rallies go on, the ruling party gains a little support every day.
spirit_desc.gen_renewal_movement: A mass movement calling for national renewal keeps widening support for fascism.
spirit_desc.gen_research_institutes: State-funded laboratories speed up every field of research a little.
spirit_desc.gen_resistance_support: Our agents and radios keep the resistance in our occupied homeland growing.
spirit_desc.gen_skilled_workforce: Graduates of the trade schools push the production lines closer to their best.
spirit_desc.gen_staff_training: Staff college graduates prepare operations sooner and pass their experience to the army.
spirit_desc.gen_strike_losses: Factories that stood idle have not yet returned to full speed.
spirit_desc.gen_war_bonds_spirit: Citizens who bought bonds see the war as their own, though they also want more consumer goods.
spirit_desc.ita_abyssinia: The war in East Africa, begun in October 1935, rallies the nation but swallows its goods.
spirit_desc.ita_armed_neutrality_spirit: Italy stays out of the war but keeps its army on the frontiers.
spirit_desc.ita_autarky_spirit: Home mines and substitutes are preferred to imports, whatever they cost.
spirit_desc.ita_axis_bond: Rome and Berlin share plans, scientists and an open hostility to the League.
spirit_desc.ita_capital_ships: The shipyards build the new battleships ahead of every other order.
spirit_desc.ita_cobelligerent_prep: While the government changes sides, the army is scattered and confused.
spirit_desc.ita_crown_shadow: The King's circle watches the government closely: decisions are slower, but a coup is harder.
spirit_desc.ita_desert_war: Units in North Africa have learned to move and supply themselves across open desert.
spirit_desc.ita_hydro_power: Alpine dams keep the northern factories running without imported coal.
spirit_desc.ita_non_belligerent: Neither neutral nor at war, Italy trades with both sides while it rearms.
spirit_desc.ita_pact: The alliance with Germany ties Italy to its partner's wars.
spirit_desc.ita_sanctions: Since November 1935 the League of Nations has restricted trade with Italy.
spirit_desc.ita_submarine_priority: The best crews and torpedoes go to the submarine flotillas.
spirit_desc.ita_torpedo_tactics: Bomber crews practise low-level torpedo runs against ships at sea.
spirit_desc.ita_war_booty_spirit: Repair teams put captured enemy equipment back into service.
spirit_desc.ita_war_mobilisation: Factories run extra shifts for the war, and the shops have less to sell.
spirit_desc.jpn_big_ship_priority: The navy trusts battleship gunfire to decide sea battles.
spirit_desc.jpn_captured_arms_spirit: Repair units put captured enemy weapons back into service.
spirit_desc.jpn_carrier_focus: Carriers operate together to land one heavy blow.
spirit_desc.jpn_cooperative_diplomacy_spirit: Respect for the treaty order with the powers stirs less international tension.
spirit_desc.jpn_garrison_system: Garrison units hold railways and towns in occupied areas, easing the field army's load.
spirit_desc.jpn_jungle_warfare: The troops have learned to hold out in forest and swamp on little supply.
spirit_desc.jpn_landing_skill: Landing troops and transports finish their preparations quickly.
spirit_desc.jpn_military_voice: The army and navy hold their ministries and weigh heavily on national policy.
spirit_desc.jpn_night_fighting: The infantry is practised at closing in by night and holding in woodland.
spirit_desc.jpn_northern_readiness: Equipment and training suited to the bitter cold of the Manchurian border.
spirit_desc.jpn_party_politics: The majority party leads the cabinet while the services stand back.
spirit_desc.jpn_service_rivalry: The army and the navy fight over budgets and over the course of national policy.
spirit_desc.jpn_submarine_squadrons: Large submarines shadow and attack the enemy fleet.
spirit_desc.jpn_surprise_prep: The carrier force rehearses striking first across the open ocean.
spirit_desc.jpn_war_administration: Ministries and control boards move under a single command.
spirit_desc.jpn_war_mobilisation: Materials and factories go to war production first under government plans.
spirit_desc.jpn_war_resolve: The decision is made: if diplomacy fails, it will be war.
spirit_desc.p4_bomber_command: A separate command plans and flies the bombing of enemy industry.
spirit_desc.p4_convoy_system: Merchant ships sail in escorted convoys from the first day of war.
spirit_desc.p4_dispersal: Factories spread out and hidden shrug off part of every bombing raid.
spirit_desc.p4_dive_bombing: Dive bombers trained to work with the army hit the enemy front harder.
spirit_desc.p4_fighter_command: A single command directs every fighter squadron at home.
spirit_desc.p4_fleet_air_arm: The navy controls its own aircraft and trains them to strike ships.
spirit_desc.p4_high_seas_fleet: A balanced battle fleet trains to fight the enemy line head on.
spirit_desc.p4_shturmovik: Armoured ground-attack aircraft fly low over the front in support of the infantry.
spirit_desc.p4_submarine_fleet: A large submarine force guards the coasts and hunts enemy shipping.
spirit_desc.p4_uboat_priority: The U-boat arm gets the best crews and first call on the yards.
spirit_desc.pol_between: Wedged between Germany and the Soviet Union, Poland keeps its army ready on both borders.
spirit_desc.sun_collective_rule: Posts are shared out by agreement, which makes it easier to bring in capable people.
spirit_desc.sun_commander_corps: Returning and recently promoted commanders are gaining experience fast.
spirit_desc.sun_consumer_line: More of the plan goes to shoes, cloth and food than to blast furnaces.
spirit_desc.sun_deep_operations: The army trains to break the front and strike the enemy's rear in one continuous operation.
spirit_desc.sun_defend_motherland: The whole nation has risen against the invader, and surrender is unthinkable.
spirit_desc.sun_design_bureau_system: Competing design bureaus turn out new weapons and machines one after another.
spirit_desc.sun_factory_relocation: Construction crews rebuild evacuated plants on open ground in the east.
spirit_desc.sun_five_year_plans: The second plan pours resources into heavy industry and freshly built plants.
spirit_desc.sun_labour_heroes: Shock workers and record-breakers set the pace in every factory.
spirit_desc.sun_power_grid: Hydroelectric power from the Dnieper keeps the southern factories running.
spirit_desc.sun_purge_1: Arrests tighten the center's grip on the party, and the officer corps begins to feel the strain.
spirit_desc.sun_purge_2: With the high command arrested, armies and corps pass to inexperienced men.
spirit_desc.sun_purge_3: Arrests reach down to regiments and battalions, and officers avoid taking any initiative.
spirit_desc.sun_purge_aftermath: Thousands of posts are held by officers promoted far beyond their experience.
spirit_desc.sun_rkka_reserves: A standing army with trained reserves can call up more men.
spirit_desc.sun_surprise_shock: The invasion caught the army unprepared: units are cut off and command is in disarray.
spirit_desc.sun_third_plan: Defense plants come first in every allocation of steel, labor and money.
spirit_desc.sun_total_mobilisation: Every age class able to bear arms has been called to the colors.
spirit_desc.sun_war_lessons: Training now follows what the fighting in Finland revealed.
spirit_desc.usa_amphibious_doctrine: Landing craft, drills and tested plans let troops go ashore with less preparation.
spirit_desc.usa_arsenal: American industry turns out weapons for itself and for every nation fighting aggression.
spirit_desc.usa_daylight_bombing: Bomber crews train to hit factories and rail yards by day with their bombsights.
spirit_desc.usa_depression: Unemployment stays high, and recovery leans on federal spending.
spirit_desc.usa_depression_eased: Renewed federal spending has softened the downturn, though millions are still out of work.
spirit_desc.usa_europe_first_spirit: Plans and shipping are geared to a landing in Europe, and the staffs work faster.
spirit_desc.usa_fortress_america: Guarded by two oceans and ready to fight on its own ground, America is a hard target.
spirit_desc.usa_great_maneuvers: The lessons of the great exercises are fresh, and commanders learn quickly.
spirit_desc.usa_isolation: The 1935 Neutrality Act and public opinion keep the country out of foreign quarrels.
spirit_desc.usa_isolation_cracked: Most Americans still want no part in the war, but fewer believe the oceans will keep it away.
spirit_desc.usa_motorised_army: An army that rides in trucks moves faster and wastes less of its supplies.
spirit_desc.usa_neutral_trade_spirit: Exporters thrive on selling to everyone, and their profits ease the burden on the home market.
spirit_desc.usa_pacific_first_spirit: Carrier strikes and island landings get the newest ships and the best crews.
spirit_desc.usa_patrol_fleet: Ships and seaplanes on patrol learn to find and shadow every vessel in their waters.
spirit_desc.usa_preparedness_spirit: Arms are ordered ahead of need, so new arms plants go up faster.
spirit_desc.usa_recovering_economy: The worst is over, but the economy still leans on public spending and patience is wearing thin.
spirit_desc.usa_two_ocean_fleet: Shipyards on both coasts work around the clock to build the new fleet.
spirit_desc.usa_unrestricted_subs: Submarines attack enemy merchant shipping without warning.
spirit_desc.usa_war_production: Civilian goods are rationed so that the factories can run flat out on war orders.
spirit_desc.vic_state_regime: Parliament has been set aside, and all power rests with the head of state and his ministers.
